object: Activation of the contained multidisciplinary review board as an internal governance mechanism for later Manzanita candidates.
mechanism: The design integrator submits one bounded object with evidence and authority limits. Twelve functional seats review the same object separately, record findings and uncertainty, exercise explicit veto jurisdiction, and return a decision record that release authority may use only within the packet's requested governance scope.

evidence.claim: Defines the complete seat roster, questions, evidence minimums, veto law, decision states, and non-authority boundary.
Defines the required object, actors, mechanism, evidence, gates, prompts, adverse-action boundary, and continuity fields.
Defines separate seat findings, defects, vetoes, gate disposition, outcome, holds, release effect, and authority receipt.
Checks exact seat coverage, evidence existence, gate law, veto law, requested authority, deterministic identity, and release-effect boundaries.
Exercises missing-seat, unknown-gate, open-veto, excessive-authority, evidence-loss, and deterministic-receipt failure modes.
Explains operation, authority, refusal behavior, activation standing, and the cold-successor control question.
Records operational governance standing while refusing product qualification and canonical task-count mutation.

claim_boundary: This packet requests admission of the contained review mechanism only. It does not request review or qualification of a Manzanita product surface, public route, provider acquisition, field action, external communication, commercial commitment, constitutional task count, or release candidate.

object_classification.reason: The submitted object is explicitly classified as an internal governance mechanism rather than a product or release.

actors_and_authority.reason: The design integrator, separate discipline seats, board chair, release authority, and cold successor have bounded and non-overlapping authority.

mechanism_fidelity.reason: The packet, decision, validator, and tests implement review coverage, evidence custody, vetoes, defects, holds, and a bounded disposition.

source_and_authorship_custody.reason: Every material governance claim is bound to a repository path and the validation receipt binds the reviewed head and file digests.

interaction_semantics.reason: This activation object exposes no end-user interactive control; later product packets must exercise interaction semantics separately.

visual_and_typographic_finish.reason: The object is a machine-readable governance mechanism and plain-text operating record, not a visual product candidate.

motion_and_temporal_continuity.reason: The activation object has no motion layer; future motion-bearing objects remain subject to the motion seat and gate.

responsive_and_accessible_operation.reason: The operating objects are structured JSON, plain Markdown, and a command-line validator with no pointer-only, color-only, or motion-only dependency.

performance_resilience_and_failure.reason: The validator uses deterministic repository-local inputs, explicit nonzero failure exits, and adversarial tests without network or credential dependence.

security_privacy_rights_and_purpose.reason: The package contains no private household data or credentials and prohibits purpose expansion, external contact, adverse action, and unbounded authority.

continuity_export_rollback_and_successio.reason: A cold successor can recover the repository paths, run the validator and tests, reproduce the receipt, and roll back by declining the branch or superseding the charter.

qualification_receipts_and_public_effect.reason: The generated receipt is bound to the validation head and explicitly records governance-only admission with no public or release effect.

board_chair: Confirm exact seat coverage, packet identity, veto disposition, requested authority, and the absence of a hidden release claim.
creative_direction: Confirm that the charter preserves a distinct creative-direction aperture for later visual objects without claiming that this governance package is a visual product.
product_interaction: Confirm that review outcomes and holds change governance state rather than merely changing labels, and that no product interaction is being qualified here.
information_design: Confirm that object, actors, mechanism, evidence, gates, defects, vetoes, holds, authority, and control question remain separately legible.
typography: Confirm that typography remains an explicit later review aperture and that plain structured text does not masquerade as a finished visual system.
motion: Confirm that motion is correctly held outside this activation object and cannot disappear from later motion-bearing reviews.
source_custody: Confirm that every activation claim has a stable repository source and that the receipt binds the exact validation head and content hashes.
field_operations: Confirm that this mechanism grants no inspection, entry, work, safety, completion, or field acceptance authority.
accessibility: Confirm that the mechanism is operable through structured text and that later product reviews retain keyboard, touch, screen-reader, zoom, and reduced-motion duties.
performance_resilience: Confirm deterministic local operation, explicit failure exits, retained diagnostics, and no dependency on a live provider for governance activation.
security_privacy: Confirm that the package contains no secret or private household payload and that purpose expansion and adverse action remain prohibited.
continuity_release: Confirm that a cold successor can reproduce the decision and that governance activation cannot be presented as product qualification, deployment, or public release.

prohibited_uses: insurance denial, underwriting, premium setting, or coverage triage
property valuation, resident scoring, or eligibility ranking
employment, access, enforcement, inspection, or punitive action
external communication or commercial commitment without accountable authorization
adverse_action_boundary.required_human_control: Any later external effect requires a separate packet, lawful authority, named accountable human decision, retained evidence, and an independently reviewable receipt.

continuity.recovery_path: Clone the repository, read the charter and schemas, run the unit suite and validator, and compare the generated receipt against the same validation head.
continuity.successor_test: A cold successor must reproduce PASS for the activation case and reproduce rejection for every adversarial mutation without relying on undocumented context.

control_question: Does this packet activate a complete evidence-backed review mechanism while preserving the boundary between internal governance, constitutional task accounting, product qualification, public release, and external action?
